title: Crystalized Blue Raspberry Lemonade 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Crystalized’s Blue Raspberry Lemonade is a lively fusion of tart Blue Raspberry and zesty Lemonade, creating a bright and effervescent vape. The bold, tangy Blue Raspberry delivers a juicy berry sharpness, while the sparkling Lemonade adds a citrusy kick with a hint of fizz. The combination results in a perfectly balanced blend of sweet, sour, and refreshing notes that linger with every puff. With a versatile 50% VG / 50% PG, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping, making it ideal for low-powered vape kits, pod systems, starter devices, and high-resistance coils. The balanced formula ensures a consistent flavour and a smooth yet tactile throat hit with discreet vapour production. As a 100ml shortfill, this nicotine-free e-liquid leaves room for two 10ml nicotine shots, allowing you to customise your strength. Adding two 18mg nic shots creates 120ml of 3mg e-liquid. Crystalized is a UK-based e-liquid brand dedicated to crafting distinctive, flavourful vape juices with an emphasis on MTL vaping. Their 50/50 VG/PG shortfills deliver clean, bright, and consistent flavours, making them an excellent choice for everyday vaping.
